title: Harness reviewer context contained the operator's personal memory

found.context: Public-release audit of archived reviewer outputs

observed_failure: CLI reviewer runs loaded the operator's personal assistant memory; reviewers flagged and ignored it, but it was quoted in 24 archived outputs.
expected_behavior: Reviewer runs see only their packet; archived outputs contain no operator data.

regression.note: not regression-testable in CI; mitigated by running reviewers through packet-only prompts (tools/rce_roles.py) and by the repository audit (tools/check_repo.py)
